source.authors: Francesco Sylos Labini, Zofia Chrobakova, Roberto Capuzzo-Dolcetta, Martin Lopez-Corredoira
source.title: Mass Models of the Milky Way and Estimation of Its Mass from the Gaia DR3 Data Set
source.transformation: Manual transcription of all 45 Table 1 rows from primary-source web-extracted text; no row exclusions, interpolation or smoothing. Independent reviewer checks transcription. Raw PDF bytes were unavailable; no PDF hash claimed.

observable: Milky Way inferred midplane circular speed in km/s at Galactocentric radius in kpc
independence: External published-data evaluation, not blind or proven independent of legacy calibration; overlap cannot be excluded. DR3+ combines Eilers2019 and Wang2023.
assumptions: Time-independent axisymmetric Jeans inference and tracer-density assumptions inherited from source
Quoted errors used diagonally; covariance and complete systematics unavailable
GalaxyRotationConstantInherited is a phenomenological candidate, not an A-115 source-derived law

diagnostic_screen.criterion: RMS residual <= 10% of mean observed circular speed
diagnostic_screen.meaning: Declared coarse discrepancy screen only; passing is not physical confirmation

source_revision_review.scope: Compression-ring terminology and internal method rename; numerical wake body AST unchanged after method-name/docstring normalization. External candidate parameters, data and equations unchanged.
